05 / COUPLE STORY

Under the trees.

A walk beneath the trees. Pale flowers, deep green, and a story told at an unhurried pace.

The canopy becomes a natural backdrop. Wider compositions hold the setting, while the closer frames stay with the people.

Concept collection · sample photographs supplied with the project, not Joseph’s commissioned work.
